svg.text: KUBECON JAPAN · MAIN TALK · STORYBOARD · 26 CORE SLIDES
A visual, end-to-end reading of the live talk: why the constraint exists → three proofs → what builders can do.

g.text: A grid that cannot borrow energy must coordinate what it has.
The energy is clean. The timing is wrong.
Solar peak and demand peak do not meet.
Power control in one interval — not GWh.
Flexibility moves supply or demand into place.
Batteries store. EVs and heat pumps shift load.
The ramp becomes smaller and easier to serve.
VPP platform for distributed energy resources.
A grid event cannot wait for a manual chain.
Policy and market framework — not one licence.
A city is a graph problem
Local autonomy acts fast; the platform coordinates intent.
Daily flexibility is a better fit for ordinary life.
Map visualises a control pattern, not company output.
Software makes a fleet act as one resource.
Event streams · fleet state · safe change · explainability
Not a magic home count — a verifiable portfolio.
The grid is a distributed system.
WE KNOW HOW TO BUILD THOSE.

svg.text: Solid content is audience-facing slide copy. Mini graphics show the intended composition, not literal production assets. Source strips / case notes: 3, 6, 10, 12, 18, 19.
